_comment: Edit subdomain values to change how dashboards appear at *.narve.ai. The 'key' is internal and must not change — it's how the gateway identifies each dashboard. The 'target' is the local port where the dashboard is actually running. Pricing is plan-level (see PLANS in server.py: Basic/Pro/Enterprise) — dashboards no longer carry their own prices. Flags: 'hidden': true removes a dashboard from every storefront surface (landing, hub, tour, billing, settings) while keeping proxying and existing subscriptions working — flip it back to relist. 'access_alias': '<key>' means a subscription to that other key unlocks this dashboard too (merged products sold under one key). 'merged_into': '<key>' marks a retired dashboard whose subdomain now 301-redirects to the absorbing dashboard; pair it with a 'legacy_grants' entry so old subscribers keep access to the merged product. 'parked': true marks a hidden dashboard whose service is intentionally not deployed: the gateway serves a parked notice on its subdomain (tallied on /admin/fleet) instead of proxying, and health probes skip it.
